criteria.commensurate: Not decidable on the case as written. It argues +13% (3.2 s) over main, but that figure is net of about 4.5 s saved on seed 39 by the route memo in ways/serve.py. That memo is a byte-identical cache, independent of the guarantees, and would speed main just as much. Against main the guarantees cost +2.4/+3.1/+1.7 s on seeds 4/25/47 (+47%) and about +8.4 s (+43%) gross over the four seeds. None of the four reference seeds re-rolls on main (every main stage but seed 39 web matches start), so the snapshot shows the guarantees' cost and none of the re-roll savings. The number to judge is +43%, weighed against the gate's 228.6 s saved and the re-rolls removed (8 of 53 maps), stated by a rewritten explanation.
criteria.necessary: Yes for the guarantees themselves. The GM asked that every rule be guaranteed by the placement algorithm rather than just happening to work on particular seeds (request.md; spec FR-001, FR-002), and the growth is in the stages that now do that work: homesteads (seat_the_rest and access_corridor, 1,122 corridor searches on seed 4, 2.1 of 5.0 profiled s), web (settle_the_web and the straggler pass), hinterland and field. The notice and windbreak drops are finished-map work that the guarantees replaced.
criteria.no_way_around: Open. The two recovery passes are real (35.0 -> 29.3 s, byte-identical), and the full-pitch-first seat lattice was measured and declined as a change of form. But the session names a lever it did not measure (dropping the straggler footpaths), and the seed 4 homesteads profile at 6e8322e3a shows the exhaustive seat pass making 779 bundle placements and 1,122 corridor searches to seat 15 households. Whether a cheaper refusal can come before the corridor search is not shown either way. To settle it: measure the straggler lever, and time the seat pass with the corridor search asked only of offers that pass every cheaper refusal.

note: Adjudicated on reviewer runs, not on the explanation: main and end alternated in detached worktrees (see the band-1 confirmation). Band 3 also owed: the GM's sign-off at a terminal; total +32.5% and every seed over 20%.
